title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments across Bryn Mawr College, from historic reading rooms to modern science hubs and late-night cafes.

cards.title: Canaday Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Main campus library with diverse seating
cards.notes: Visit the first floor for Quita's Corner pleasure reading or head to upper floors for quiet carrels and group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: The central library offering a mix of collaborative zones, quiet carrels, and specialized rooms like the Writing Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Canaday Library features Quita's Corner on the first floor, group study rooms on the 3rd floor, and is the main campus library.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with OneCard; hours vary by semester, typically opening at 9am.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sunlit tables near the glass wall
cards.notes: Spread out at the large tables near the atrium wall to enjoy natural light and views of the surrounding architecture.
cards.short_summary: A modern, spacious library addition known for its high ceilings, natural light, and proximity to the Old Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Carpenter Library features over 100 carrels and large tables near the atrium wall that provide significant natural light.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the Tri-Co community; features quiet carrels and collaborative classrooms.

cards.title: Collier Science Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet research space in Park Science Center
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of Park Science for a quiet environment ideal for STEM research and focused individual work.
cards.short_summary: Located within the Park Science Center, this library offers specialized collections and quiet reading areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collier Science Library Reading Room is located on the third floor of the Marion Park Science Building.
cards.source_title: Collier Science Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open for studying and collaborating; includes group and individual study rooms reservable via LibCal.

cards.title: Quita Woodward Room
cards.subtitle: Historic lounge in the Old Library
cards.notes: Find a cozy armchair among floor-to-ceiling bookshelves for a quiet, traditional academic atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A wood-paneled, historic room in the Old Library building used for quiet study and small gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quita Woodward Room is located in the Old Library and features casual chairs and bookshelves.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Old Library; typically available for quiet study when not reserved for events.

cards.title: The Lusty Cup
cards.subtitle: Late-night student-run cafe
cards.notes: Visit this basement cafe in Canaday Library for a social study environment and late-night caffeine.
cards.short_summary: A student-run cafe located in the basement of Canaday Library, popular for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lusty Cup is a late-night café located on the lower floor of Canaday Library.
cards.source_title: The Lusty Cup - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open late nights, typically 8pm-12am; check current semester hours.

cards.title: Uncommon Grounds
cards.subtitle: Campus Center social study hub
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a spot in the lounge for group work or casual reading in a lively atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus cafe located in the Bern Schwartz Gymnasium/Campus Center complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Uncommon Grounds is located inside the Campus Center and offers a social atmosphere for studying.
cards.access_notes: Open during daytime and evening hours; seating is open to all students.

cards.title: Dalton Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Glass-walled study area
cards.notes: Use the swiveling chairs on the upper floors of the atrium for a bright space with views of the campus green.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass atrium within the historic Dalton Hall providing natural light and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The glass atrium of Dalton Hall offers swiveling chairs and significant natural light for studying.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Park Science Center Ground Floor
cards.subtitle: Collaborative space with chalkboards
cards.notes: Utilize the moveable tables and wall-to-wall chalkboards for mapping out complex equations or group projects.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated science hub featuring open collaborative spaces and modern academic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The ground floor of Park Science Center features chalkboards and moveable tables for student use.
cards.source_title: Renovation Revitalizes Park Science Center - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; renovated in 2025 to enhance collaborative study areas.

cards.title: The London Room
cards.subtitle: Secluded study nook in Thomas Hall
cards.notes: Locate this quiet room off the Great Hall for a focused session surrounded by historic British literature.
cards.short_summary: A small, quiet study room located within Thomas Hall (Old Library) known for its cozy atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The London Room is a cozy room in Thomas Hall with elegant windows and books about England.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Great Hall; limited seating makes it a quiet, sought-after spot.

cards.title: New Dorm Dining Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Versatile dining and study area
cards.notes: Use the versatile dining rooms for group meetings or a quiet meal while catching up on reading.
cards.short_summary: A modern dining facility that doubles as a student gathering and study space outside of peak meal times.
cards.evidence_claim: New Dorm Dining Hall offers versatile dining rooms suitable for group meetings of eight or more.
cards.source_title: New Dorm Dining Hall - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open during dining hours; features conference rooms and diverse seating options.
